Test-optional; scores may be self-reported or sent officially. Superscores SAT and ACT. 39% of the Class of 2030 applied test-optional

Required (with FAFSA) for institutional aid; no CSS fee waivers from W&M. Fall 2027 entrants file 2027-28 forms. Priority dates: ED I Nov 15, ED II Jan 15, RD Feb 1
